description: Electrical installation data (card M1-08, P Part 2 'electrical defaults are installation parameters'). Per engine id, else 'default'. Alternator figures that come from manufacturer documents are marked PUBLIC/OWNER with refs; the rest is ASSUMED installation data.

bus_nominal_v.ref: 14 V bus (P Part 2: bus voltage is an installation parameter, some airframes run 28 V)

battery_capacity_ah.ref: typical light-aircraft / MALE UAV 12 V battery

battery_ocv_full_v.ref: 12 V battery open-circuit voltage at 100 % state of charge

battery_ocv_empty_v.ref: open-circuit voltage at 0 % usable charge (linear OCV model)

battery_internal_ohm.ref: internal resistance of a healthy 18 Ah battery

load_w.ref: engine ECU + fuel pumps + avionics + payload load on the bus

full_output_rpm.ref: full rated current from this engine rpm

rated_a.ref: rotax-owner.com 912iS generator/lane description (P Part 2, needs OM confirmation)

cut_in_rpm.ref: ECU moves to Gen A above ~2500 rpm (P Part 2)
